fact: The Minister of Economy and Finance said the Dossier virtuel de transaction is implemented through GUCE-Niger, the foreign trade single window, to ease exchanges between operators and the administrations concerned, with DVT control integrated into processing of operations from 1 July 2026.
Webb Fontaine Niger's director general said GUCE-Niger connects customs, ministries, banks and control bodies such as OCRTIS on a single platform for synchronised processing of requests.

Webb Fontaine Niger's general manager said the Foreign Trade Single Window GUCE-Niger launched in May 2022, with modules for licences and permits from several ministries and the Chamber of Commerce, and LPCO 2 deployed in March 2024.
